events.subject: self
events.quote: He was able to attend Bergen Cathedral School and in 1904 Kristiania Cathedral School .

events.text: Øverland published his first collection of poems.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Øverland published his first collection of poems ( 1911 ) .

events.subject: self
events.quote: Øverland became a communist sympathizer from the early 1920s

events.text: Øverland became a member of Mot Dag.
events.subject: self
events.quote: became a member of Mot Dag

events.text: Øverland served as chairman of the Norwegian Students Society.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He also served as chairman of the Norwegian Students Society 1923–28 .

events.text: Øverland wrote the poem Du må ikke sove.
events.subject: self
events.quote: in 1936 he wrote the poem Du må ikke sove which was printed in the journal Samtiden

events.text: Øverland and his future wife Margrete Aamot Øverland were arrested.
events.subject: self
events.quote: leading to the arrest of both him and his future wife Margrete Aamot Øverland in 1941

events.text: Øverland's four-year imprisonment ended with the liberation of Norway.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He spent a four-year imprisonment until the liberation of Norway in 1945 .

events.text: His poems were collected in Vi overlever alt and published.
events.subject: self
events.quote: His poems were later collected in Vi overlever alt and published in 1945 .

events.subject: self
events.quote: he has been president of Riksmålsforbundet ( an organization in support of Riksmål ) since 1947

events.text: His speech Tungetale fra parnasset was published in Arbeiderbladet.
events.subject: self
events.quote: His speech Tungetale fra parnasset , published in Arbeiderbladet in 1954
